rules.title: No criminal-record inquiries before conditional offer
rules.requirement: Housing providers may not require applications containing criminal-record questions, or make oral or written criminal-record inquiries, before making a conditional offer (limited exceptions for methamphetamine manufacture in federally assisted housing and lifetime sex-offender registration).
rules.coverage_text: Rental dwelling units offered for rent by a housing provider, other than units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.

exemption_tests.description: Dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.

rules.exemptions_text: Dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.ambiguity_note: Act takes effect the first day of the seventh month after enactment (approved June 18, 2021); date derived from that formula, not stated explicitly.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
rules.key_value: Fair chance: no criminal record inquiry before conditional offer
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 (first violation), $5,000 (one prior violation in 5 years), $10,000 (two or more prior violations in 7 years); possible return of application fee and up to $1,000 paid to applicant.

rules.title: Written disclosure of criminal history screening before accepting application fee
rules.requirement: Before accepting any application fee, a housing provider must disclose in writing whether its eligibility criteria include review of criminal history and that the applicant may provide evidence of inaccuracies, rehabilitation or mitigating factors.

rules.title: Prohibited types of criminal records
rules.requirement: Before or after a conditional offer, housing providers may not evaluate applicants based on non-conviction arrests or charges, expunged, pardoned, vacated or sealed records, or juvenile adjudications.

rules.title: Limited post-offer consideration of convictions with look-back periods
rules.requirement: After a conditional offer, only certain convictions may be considered: listed serious offenses or lifetime registry crimes, and first-degree (6 years), second/third-degree (4 years), and fourth-degree (1 year) indictable offenses within look-back periods.

rules.title: Conditions on withdrawing conditional offer; individualized assessment and notice
rules.requirement: A conditional offer may be withdrawn based on criminal record only if necessary to fulfill a substantial, legitimate, nondiscriminatory interest by a preponderance of evidence, after an individualized assessment of listed factors, with written notice stating reasons and an opportunity to appeal.

rules.quoted_span: A housing provider may withdraw a conditional offer based on an applicant's criminal record only if the housing provider determines, by preponderance of the evidence, that the withdrawal is necessary to fulfill a substantial, legitimate, and nondiscriminatory interest.

rules.title: Applicant's right to copy of information relied upon
rules.requirement: Within 30 days after notice of withdrawal an applicant may request all information relied upon, including criminal records; the housing provider must provide it free of charge within 10 days of a timely request.

rules.title: Ban on advertisements and forms excluding applicants with criminal records
rules.requirement: Housing providers may not publish advertisements stating they will not consider applicants arrested or convicted of crimes, or use forms or statements expressing unlawful limitations as to criminal record, except as permitted by the act.

rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not knowingly or purposefully publish, or cause to be published, any housing advertisement that explicitly provides that the housing provider will not consider any applicant who has been arrested or convicted of one or more crimes or offenses, except for drug-related criminal activity for the manufacture or production of methamphetamine on the premises of federally assisted housing, and whether the applicant is subject to a lifetime registration requirement under a State sex offender registration program.

rules.title: Limits on dissemination and use of applicant criminal records
rules.requirement: Unless otherwise required by law, housing providers may not disseminate an applicant's criminal record to persons not expected to use it to evaluate the applicant consistently with the act, or use it for inconsistent purposes.

rules.title: No drug or alcohol testing or drug treatment information requirement
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not require an applicant to submit to a drug or alcohol test or request consent to obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.
